//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the NAVBAR shell — the `.pc-navbar` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Layout.navbar/1`, svelte `layout/Navbar.svelte`). This is a SHELL component migrated DOWN into @keenmate/pure-css, so the block class is `pc-navbar` (NOT `pa-navbar`); confirmed in dist/css/main.css (~9 `.pc-navbar*` selectors). SCOPE = CAPABILITY-ONLY, ZERO strict-compare scenarios — the same path settings-panel.json / command-palette.json took, because the two wrappers' PRE-JS-hook SSR shells are IRRECONCILABLE BY DESIGN on the ONE element both ALWAYS emit, `.pc-navbar__inner`: keen stamps it with a `phx-hook="PureAdminNavFit"` (stripped by the normalizer, fine) AND a NON-DETERMINISTIC generated `id="pc-navbar-inner-{System.unique_integer}"` (the NavFit hook needs a stable DOM id); svelte emits a BARE `<div class="pc-navbar__inner">` and attaches the same fit engine via `onMount` at RUNTIME (which the pre-JS-hook dumper never runs), so NO id and NO hook in its SSR. The normalizer keeps `id` (it only documents stripping GENERATED ids but the code never actually matches a generated-id pattern — see normalize.mjs IGNORE_ATTRS), so keen's per-render id survives and can never equal svelte's absent id. A shared golden therefore can't even write the `__inner` opening tag. Everything INSIDE the zones (brand=pc-app-header, nav=pc-navmenu, page title=pc-page-header, search=pc-navbar-search, notifications=pa-notifications, profile=pc-navbar__profile-btn) is supplied by SEPARATE sub-components fed through the start/center/end SLOTS — out of scope here (container-only), deferred as prose. Because there is no shared full-tree golden, compare passes vacuously (0/0 both wrappers) and correctness is asserted by the completeness contract: the base `pc-navbar` class + its structural element classes (__inner/__start/__center/__end) exercised-by-prose-defer + the shared `extraClass` class-passthrough feature (both wrappers accept `class` on the root) + every __* element class accounted for. Canonical shape: packages/core/snippets/layout.html (NAVBAR / HEADER section).

propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the root <nav class="pc-navbar ..."> (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, the one shared SSR feature; not a core modifier.

goldenConventions: No scenarios → no goldens. See the leading note for why a shared full-tree golden is impossible: the always-present `.pc-navbar__inner` carries keen's non-deterministic generated hook id (needed by the NavFit hook) that svelte attaches at runtime instead, so the `__inner` opening tag can't reconcile. Correctness is carried by the structural contract: the base `pc-navbar` block class, the class-passthrough feature, and the deferred element-class inventory (zones + slot-fed sub-component elements). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace would be normalized away if a golden existed.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pc-navbar(--|__)'). The `.pc-navbar` BLOCK has ZERO modifiers (no `.pc-navbar--*` in main.css). Its element classes are __inner / __start / __center / __end (the shell zones, container-emitted) + __burger / __profile-btn / __profile-name (slot-fed from sub-components: navbar_burger, profile_button). NOTE `.pc-navbar-search*` is a DIFFERENT block (`pc-navbar-search`, note the `-search` not `__`/`--`), so the ^pc-navbar__ / ^pc-navbar-- axis-1 regexes never match it. The ONE shared SSR feature is the class passthrough; everything else is structural/slot-fed and deferred. `produces: null` everywhere — no block modifier exists.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim to the root pc-navbar nav; svelte `class`, keen `class`. Declared in both maps for axis-2; not exercised by a strict scenario (capability-only fixture).

deferred.//: Every element class of the pc-navbar block. The SHELL ZONES (__inner/__start/__center/__end) ARE emitted by the container in SSR, but they can't be strict-compared because __inner carries keen's non-deterministic hook id (see the leading note) and the zones are conditionally rendered around framework-divergent chrome; acknowledged as PROSE. The SLOT-FED elements (__burger/__profile-btn/__profile-name) come from SEPARATE sub-components (navbar_burger / profile_button, each its own future slice) fed through the zone slots — container-only scope defers them. All class names exist in main.css and are emitted identically-named by both wrappers; only the hook-id + surrounding content diverge.
deferred.pc-navbar__inner: inner flex container; the navbar-fit container. keen stamps a non-deterministic generated id + phx-hook here (NavFit needs a stable DOM id); svelte attaches the same engine at onMount (no SSR id/hook). Irreconcilable opening tag → no strict golden.
deferred.pc-navbar__start: START zone (inline-start): brand + primary nav. Conditionally rendered (keen :if slot non-empty; svelte {#if start}); content is slot-fed sub-components.
deferred.pc-navbar__center: CENTER zone (flex:1): page title / search. Conditionally rendered; slot-fed.
deferred.pc-navbar__end: END zone (inline-end): secondary nav, notifications, profile. Conditionally rendered; slot-fed.
deferred.pc-navbar__burger: burger anchor (first child of __inner); emitted by the navbar_burger / burger sub-component, not the container shell — its own future slice.
deferred.pc-navbar__profile-btn: profile button; emitted by the profile_button sub-component fed into the END zone — its own future slice.
deferred.pc-navbar__profile-name: profile display-name span inside the profile button — part of the profile_button sub-component.
